people.name: Sisera
people.line: Canaanite commander defeated by Deborah and Barak.

translations.web: From the sky the stars fought. From their courses, they fought against Sisera.
translations.bsb: From the heavens the stars fought; from their courses they fought against Sisera.
translations.kjv: They fought from heaven; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera.
translations.asv: From heaven fought the stars, From their courses they fought against Sisera.
